headline: X Antoine Griezmann se burló de Sergio Ramos y del Real Madrid después de ganar la UEFA Supercopa de Europa
content: Además.- Arey muerto, rey puesto. El Atlético de Madrid acabó con el reinado europeo del Real Madrid y Antoine Griezmann lo celebró molestándose del defensor Sergio Ramos, quien se había disfrazado de monarca en los últimos festejos blancos. The French player uploaded his social networks a drawing where the defender could see himself crowned over the forward, who appeared sitting on a throne dressed like during Medieval times. ‘The Little Prince’ didn’t accompany the picture with any phrase but put some laughing emojis as way of mocking. The publication was made through stories of Instagram which last for just 24 hours online but fans immediately captured the postcard and went viral sharing it also in Facebook and Twitter, making fun of the supporters of the white team while entertaining others.
